Timings and Information
Breakfast club starts at 7.30am and after school wraparound care runs until 6pm each day. Full details of our wrap around care service can be seen in our Wraparound-Contract-1.pdf
Bookings
Parents who need to book after school and breakfast club should complete our electronic booking form, this has already been sent to all parents. If you cannot find it, please contact the academy office, who will be happy to send it again. Once you have completed this, you will be notified if there is a vacancy for your child and be sent details of how to pay. Please note that your child's place is not secure until you have paid and returned the completed the contract to the academy. If you wish to contact us, please email wraparoundcare@harrisprimarypurleyway.org.uk

Welcome
It is a pleasure to welcome you to our website.
Thank you for your interest in Harris Primary Academy Purley Way, whether you are a prospective parent or simply finding out more about our academy.
Since opening in September 2016, Harris Primary Academy Purley Way has grown from a single Reception cohort to a thriving, three-form entry primary school with 630 pupils across 21 classes from Reception to Year 6. We are proud to be recognised by Ofsted as Outstanding.
At the heart of our academy is a commitment to ensuring that every child feels safe, happy and respected. This is embodied in our vision, “Excellence for All”, and underpinned by our core values of Positivity, Ambition and Integrity. These values guide everything we do and are lived out by our pupils, staff and families each day.
Through exceptional teaching, high expectations and a nurturing environment, our pupils achieve outstanding outcomes year after year. While we are immensely proud of their academic success, we are equally committed to developing confident, resilient and compassionate young people. We strive to make our academy a place where children are excited to come each dayready to learn, grow and fulfil their potential.
Please contact us on info@harrisprimarypurleyway.org.uk or 0203 872 1970 to arrange a visit if you are interested in enrolling your child with us, applying for a job vacancy we have advertised or finding out more about our academy.

Ethos and Values
Ethos and Values
The whole community strive for Harris Primary Academy Purley Way to be best it can possibly be which is encapsulated by our vision statement: “Excellence for All”. Our core values of: Positivity, Ambition and Integrity, underpin everything that happens in our academy and we have high expectations that these are followed and modelled by all staff, parents and children.
As a result of the exceptional practice at our school every single day our children achieve outstanding outcomes each year and we are incredibly proud of them. Alongside academic achievement, we want our academy to be a safe and caring space with the children excited and happy to come to school every day to learn, grow and develop.
HPAPW Community Champions
Our Community Champion themes are revisited each year, to ensure children leave HPAPW with a clear understanding and commitment to being champions of these areas in their future lives. We feel passionate that these themes should be taught discretely and form the foundation for their time at HPAPW. Although a termly theme has been chosen, this does not mean to say these topics are not covered throughout the year. Furthermore, we intend to add other key advocates to the overview in the document below and welcome any suggestions. We enjoy working with our parents and local community to support us with our challenges and events.

Ethos and Values
The whole community strive for Harris Primary Academy Purley Way to be best it can possibly be which is encapsulated by our vision statement: “Excellence for All”. Our core values of: Positivity, Ambition and Integrity, underpin everything that happens in our academy and we have high expectations that these are followed and modelled by all staff, parents and children.
As a result of the exceptional practice at our school every single day our children achieve outstanding outcomes each year and we are incredibly proud of them. Alongside academic achievement, we want our academy to be a safe and caring space with the children excited and happy to come to school every day to learn, grow and develop.
HPAPW Community Champions
Our Community Champion themes are revisited each year, to ensure children leave HPAPW with a clear understanding and commitment to being champions of these areas in their future lives. We feel passionate that these themes should be taught discretely and form the foundation for their time at HPAPW. Although a termly theme has been chosen, this does not mean to say these topics are not covered throughout the year. Furthermore, we intend to add other key advocates to the overview in the document below and welcome any suggestions. We enjoy working with our parents and local community to support us with our challenges and events.

Academy Admissions
Academy Admissions
Welcome to the Harris Primary Academy Purley Way Admissions Information page. Places at the Academy are open to all children.
Reception Applications
The Academy has an admission number of 90 in Reception.
Applications for places in Reception should be made on the home London Borough of Croydon’s e-admissions portal. This is accessible on their website and should be submitted in accordance with the published deadlines for applications (on or before 15th January 2026). Until 31st August 2027, applications for starting Reception in September 2027 should still be made in the same way but will be considered late.
For more information on joining our academy please visit our 'Join our Academy' page.
More detailed information about the admission process can be found on the https://www.croydon.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2026-08/Croydon-Primary-School-Admissions-prospectus-2027.pdf or the e-admissions help guide.
Reception Key Dates
Online Application Process opens
Deadline for receipt of applications
National Offer Day (Outcomes published to parent/carer)
Deadline for receipt of acceptances
Deadline for appeals to be made in writing to the Academy
Until 31st August 2027
Parents wishing to join the new Reception cohort must contact Croydon council.
Parents wishing to join must re-apply directly to the academy.
Appeals
If you are unhappy that you did not receive an offer of a school place at Harris Primary Academy Purley Way, you have the right to lodge an independent appeal with us.
Parents / Carers wishing to appeal against the Academy’s decision on admissions, for any year group, should contact the Academy and request an Appeal Form stating the reason for the appeal, based on the published Admissions Criteria.
Completed forms should be sent to the Clerk to the Appeal Panel at:
Harris Primary Academy Purley Way, 47 Propeller Crescent, Waddon, Surrey, CR0 4FE.
All appeals will be heard within 40 school days of the deadline for lodging appeals.
The appeals will be heard, in private, by an Independent appeal Panel. The Clerk to the Appeal Panel will make an appointment within a reasonable time, Appeals may be made in English or the Parents’/ Carers’ first language.
Appeals are conducted in person, and you may bring a friend.
The Academy will arrange for an Independent Appeals Panel to consider the Academy's reasons for refusal and your reasons for wanting to attend the Academy.
The Panel will consist of 3 people (2 will have education experience and one will be an independent person with no education experience).
The Panel will consider the case put forward by you and the Academy. They must consider the admission arrangements for the Academy and the reasons why you want to attend that particular school. The Panel must exercise its discretion by balancing the weight of your argument (for wanting to attend) against the Academy’s reasons for refusal i.e. the prejudice that one more student would cause to the education of the students already offered and the Health and Safety of all the students already attending the Academy, also taking into account the Academy's published admission arrangements.
The decision of the Independent Appeals Panel is binding on the admissions authority and the Parents.
Only one appeal per application is allowed.
In-Year Applications
If you are looking for a place in Harris Primary Academy Purley Way because you have recently moved into the area, or your child is at another primary school and you feel that a change of school would benefit their education you are entitled to apply for a school place.
Since September 2013, the law allows you to apply directly to a school or Academy instead of the Local Authority.
You can complete our 'In-year Admission Form' electronically by clicking In-Year Admissions Form 26 - 27 – Fill in form
Please note that there is no guarantee that a place will be available but completing this form will mean you will be offered a place or be added to our waiting list.
If you are interested in joining our academy please email info@harrisprimarypurleyway.org.uk to book a one to one tour of the school.
Deferred/Delayed Entry
Deferring Entry Within the Same Academic Year - You have a legal right to defer your child's start date until later in the same school year, without losing the offered place, as long as they start by the beginning of the term after their fifth birthday.
Requesting a Delayed Entry to the Following Academic Year (For Summer-Born Children) - For children born between 1 April and 31 August (summer-born), you can request to delay their entry so they start Reception a full year later, in the September following their fifth birthday.
To make this request and for further guidance, it is recommended to contact the Croydon Council Admissions Team https://www.croydon.gov.uk/schools-and-education/schools/school-admissions/admission-children-outside-their-normal-year-group
If you have any questions regarding admissions, please contact our Admissions Officer.

ParentPay - Our new online payment service
We are pleased to announce that we are now accepting payments online for items such as dinner money and school trips. Using a secure website called ParentPay you will be able to pay online using your credit or debit card. ParentPay will be our preferred method of making payments to school.
What are the benefits to parents and pupils?
What are the benefits to our school?
The more parents that use ParentPay, the greater the benefit is to our school.
You can help us reduce workloads for all staff, creating more time to lend to educational support and the smooth running of the school.
Using ParentPay also ensures financial transactions are safe and secure - helping us to remove costs associated with us having to manage cash securely on the school premises.
If you want to find out more about ParentPay, go to: www.parentpay.com
